stages.name: White Cross
stages.description: Build a white cross whose edge colors also match the side centers. This step is intuitive: no algorithms, just planning.
stages.goal: All four white edges are home: white faces the white center and the other color matches its side center.
tips: Centers never move relative to each other, so they tell you where every piece belongs.
Solve one edge at a time. Bring it to the face opposite its slot, line its side color up with the matching center, then turn that face twice.
Don't worry if the cross is on top or bottom — progress is measured relative to the centers.

stages.name: White Corners
stages.description: Hold the cross on the bottom (yellow on top) and insert the four white corners to finish the first layer.
stages.goal: The whole white layer is solved, and its side colors match the centers.
tips: Find a white corner in the top layer and turn U until it sits directly above the slot where its colors belong.
Turn the cube (y) so that slot is front-right, then repeat R U R' U' until the corner drops in solved.
A white corner stuck in the bottom layer in the wrong spot? Do R U R' U' once to lift it up.

algorithms.name: Right trigger
algorithms.description: With the corner above the front-right slot, repeat until the corner is solved (1–5 times).
algorithms.recognition: White corner in the top layer, directly above its front-right slot.

algorithms.name: Left trigger
algorithms.description: Mirror of the right trigger, for a corner above the front-left slot.
algorithms.recognition: White corner in the top layer, directly above its front-left slot.

stages.name: Middle Layer Edges
stages.description: Keep yellow on top and insert the four middle edges without disturbing the white layer.
stages.goal: The first two layers are complete: the white layer plus the middle ring all match their centers.
tips: Find a top-layer edge with no yellow. Turn U so its front color matches the front center (forming an upside-down T).
If its top color matches the right center, insert right; if it matches the left center, insert left.
An edge stuck in the middle layer upside down? Insert any top edge into that slot to pop it out.

algorithms.name: Insert right
algorithms.notation: U R U' R' U' F' U F
algorithms.description: Moves the front-top edge into the front-right slot.
algorithms.recognition: Front color matches the front center; top color matches the right center.

algorithms.name: Insert left
algorithms.notation: U' L' U L U F U' F'
algorithms.description: Moves the front-top edge into the front-left slot.
algorithms.recognition: Front color matches the front center; top color matches the left center.

stages.name: Yellow Cross
stages.description: Orient the yellow edges to make a yellow cross on top. The corners don't matter yet.
stages.goal: The top face shows a yellow + (all four yellow edges face up).

algorithms.name: Edge flip
algorithms.notation: F R U R' U' F'
algorithms.description: Flips two top edges. Hold the case as shown, then apply.

cases.name: Line
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F'
cases.description: Two opposite edges are yellow. Hold the line horizontal and apply once.
cases.recognition: Yellow line through the center, left to right.

cases.name: L-Shape
cases.moves: F R U R' U' R U R' U' F'
cases.description: Two adjacent edges are yellow. Hold the L at back-left and do the trigger twice inside F … F'.
cases.recognition: Yellow center plus the back and left edges.

cases.name: Dot
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F' U2 F R U R' U' R U R' U' F'
cases.description: No edges are yellow. Do the line algorithm once to make an L, then solve the L.
cases.recognition: Only the center is yellow.

stages.name: Yellow Face
stages.description: Twist the yellow corners so the whole top face is yellow, using Sune (and its mirror).
stages.goal: The entire top face is yellow. Side colors of the last layer may still be wrong.
tips: Exactly one corner yellow on top (a fish)? It's a Sune or Anti-Sune.
No yellow corners on top, or two? Do a Sune with a yellow sticker on the left side of the front-left corner — you'll get a fish next.

algorithms.name: Sune
algorithms.notation: R U R' U R U2 R'
algorithms.description: Twists three corners. Repeat with re-recognition until the face is yellow.

cases.name: Sune
cases.moves: R U R' U R U2 R'
cases.description: One corner yellow on top — put it front-left.
cases.recognition: Fish: one yellow corner on top; the front-right corner's yellow faces front.

cases.name: Anti-Sune
cases.moves: R U2 R' U' R U' R'
cases.description: Mirror fish — the yellow corner goes back-right.
cases.recognition: Fish: one yellow corner on top; the front-left corner's yellow faces front.

stages.name: Position Yellow Corners
stages.description: Swap the yellow corners into their correct spots while keeping the top face yellow.
stages.goal: All four top corners are solved (their side colors match the centers).
tips: Look for headlights: two corners on one side with the same color. Turn U to line them up with their center.
Hold the headlights at the back and apply the A-perm. No headlights? Apply it from any side, then look again.

algorithms.name: A-perm
algorithms.notation: R' F R' B2 R F' R' B2 R2
algorithms.description: Cycles three corners and keeps the yellow face intact. Headlights go at the back.
algorithms.recognition: Headlights (two matching corner stickers) on one side.

stages.name: Permute Yellow Edges
stages.description: Cycle the yellow edges into place to finish the cube.
tips: Find the side whose edge is already solved (a full bar) and hold it at the back.
No solved side? Apply either U-perm from anywhere, then look again.

algorithms.name: U-perm
algorithms.notation: R U' R U R U R U' R' U' R2
algorithms.description: Cycles three edges. Solved bar at the back.

cases.name: Ua-perm
cases.moves: R U' R U R U R U' R' U' R2
cases.description: Front edge needs to go left.
cases.recognition: Solved bar at the back; the front edge belongs on the left.

cases.name: Ub-perm
cases.moves: R2 U R U R' U' R' U' R' U R'
cases.description: Front edge needs to go right.
cases.recognition: Solved bar at the back; the front edge belongs on the right.

stages.name: Efficient Cross
stages.description: Build the cross on the bottom in 8 moves or fewer, planning the whole thing during inspection.
stages.goal: All four cross edges solved, ideally in ≤8 moves, with the cross on the bottom.
tips: Plan the first two edges before turning. Their relative position matters more than their absolute position.
Solving on the bottom means you can see F2L pieces right away.

stages.name: F2L (First Two Layers)
stages.description: Pair each white corner with its middle edge in the top layer, then insert the pair in one go.
stages.goal: All four F2L slots are filled.
tips: Learn F2L intuitively first: separate the pieces, pair them up with U moves, then insert.
Keep the slot you're working on at front-right where possible.

algorithms.name: Basic insert (right)
algorithms.description: The pair is already connected in the top layer; insert it with an R trigger.
algorithms.recognition: Pair at back-top, white facing right.

algorithms.name: Basic insert (left)
algorithms.description: Mirror: insert a connected pair with an L trigger.
algorithms.recognition: Pair at back-top on the left, white facing left.

algorithms.name: Split pair (right)
algorithms.notation: R U R' U' R U R' U'
algorithms.description: Corner and edge separated in the top layer: the trigger pairs them while inserting.
algorithms.recognition: Corner above the slot with white facing up.

algorithms.name: Corner in slot
algorithms.notation: R U' R' U R U' R'
algorithms.description: Corner already in its slot; bring the edge in with paired triggers.
algorithms.recognition: Corner solved in the slot, edge in the top layer.

stages.name: OLL (2-Look)
stages.description: Orient the last layer in two looks: first make the yellow cross (3 cases), then orient corners (7 cases).
stages.goal: The entire top face is yellow.

algorithms.name: Edge orientation
algorithms.notation: F R U R' U' F'
algorithms.description: First look: make the yellow cross.

cases.name: Line
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F'
cases.description: Hold the line horizontal.
cases.recognition: Horizontal yellow line.

cases.name: L-Shape
cases.moves: f R U R' U' f'
cases.description: Hold the L at front-right.
cases.recognition: Yellow front and right edges.

cases.name: Dot
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F' f R U R' U' f'
cases.description: Line then L, merged.
cases.recognition: Only the center is yellow.

algorithms.name: Corner orientation
algorithms.notation: R U R' U R U2 R'
algorithms.description: Second look: orient the corners with the cross already done.

cases.name: Sune
cases.moves: R U R' U R U2 R'
cases.description: One yellow corner on top, at front-left.
cases.recognition: Fish; front-right yellow faces front.

cases.name: Anti-Sune
cases.moves: R U2 R' U' R U' R'
cases.description: One yellow corner on top, mirror fish (yellow corner at back-right).
cases.recognition: Fish; front-left yellow faces front.

cases.name: H
cases.moves: R U R' U R U' R' U R U2 R'
cases.description: No corners on top; yellow pairs face left and right.
cases.recognition: Two pairs of headlights on opposite sides.

cases.name: Pi
cases.moves: R U2 R2 U' R2 U' R2 U2 R
cases.description: No corners on top; headlights on the left.
cases.recognition: Headlights on one side, single yellows on both adjacent sides.

cases.name: Headlights
cases.moves: R2 D' R U2 R' D R U2 R
cases.description: Two yellow corners on top at the front; headlights face the back.
cases.recognition: Two adjacent yellow corners on top; the other two show headlights.

cases.name: T (Chameleon)
cases.moves: r U R' U' r' F R F'
cases.description: Two yellow corners on top at the right; the left corners' yellows face front and back.
cases.recognition: Two adjacent yellow corners on top; the other two point away from each other.

cases.name: Bowtie
cases.moves: F' r U R' U' r' F R
cases.description: Two diagonal corners on top.
cases.recognition: Yellow corners diagonal on top.

stages.name: OLL (Full)
stages.description: Orient the whole last layer in one look. Start with the most common cases below; there are 57 in total.
stages.goal: One algorithm orients the entire last layer.

algorithms.name: Common OLLs
algorithms.notation: R U R' U R U2 R'
algorithms.description: A starter set of one-look OLLs.

cases.name: OLL 1
cases.moves: R U2 R2 F R F' U2 R' F R F'
cases.description: Dot with no corners oriented.
cases.recognition: Only the center is yellow; bars on left and right.

cases.name: OLL 2
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F' f R U R' U' f'
cases.description: Dot case.
cases.recognition: Only the center is yellow.

cases.name: OLL 33
cases.moves: R U R' U' R' F R F'
cases.description: T-shape, shoelaces.
cases.recognition: Yellow T across the middle.

cases.name: OLL 37 (Fish)
cases.moves: F R' F' R U R U' R'
cases.description: Fish shape.
cases.recognition: Fish with two side yellows at front.

cases.name: OLL 44
cases.moves: f R U R' U' f'
cases.description: P-shape.
cases.recognition: Yellow P shape.

cases.name: OLL 45
cases.moves: F R U R' U' F'
cases.description: T-shape.
cases.recognition: Yellow T.

cases.name: OLL 51
cases.moves: f R U R' U' R U R' U' f'
cases.description: Line case with bars.
cases.recognition: Horizontal line with no corners.

cases.name: OLL 57 (H)
cases.moves: R U R' U' M' U R U' r'
cases.description: All corners oriented, two edges not.
cases.recognition: Yellow H shape.

stages.name: PLL (2-Look)
stages.description: Permute the last layer in two looks: corners first (2 cases), then edges (4 cases).

algorithms.name: Corner permutation
algorithms.notation: R' F R' B2 R F' R' B2 R2

cases.name: A-perm (adjacent)
cases.moves: R' F R' B2 R F' R' B2 R2
cases.description: Headlights on one side — hold them at the back.
cases.recognition: Exactly one side has headlights.

cases.name: Y-perm (diagonal)
cases.moves: F R U' R' U' R U R' F' R U R' U' R' F R F'
cases.description: No headlights: swap two diagonal corners.
cases.recognition: No side has headlights.

algorithms.name: Edge permutation
algorithms.notation: R U' R U R U R U' R' U' R2

cases.name: Ua-perm
cases.moves: R U' R U R U R U' R' U' R2
cases.description: Solved bar at the back; three edges cycle.
cases.recognition: One solved side; the front edge belongs left.

cases.name: Ub-perm
cases.moves: R2 U R U R' U' R' U' R' U R'
cases.description: Mirror of Ua.
cases.recognition: One solved side; the front edge belongs right.

cases.name: H-perm
cases.moves: M2 U M2 U2 M2 U M2
cases.description: Opposite edges swap.
cases.recognition: Every side shows the opposite color in the middle.

cases.name: Z-perm
cases.moves: M' U M2 U M2 U M' U2 M2
cases.description: Adjacent edges swap in pairs.
cases.recognition: Every side shows an adjacent color in the middle.

stages.name: PLL (Full)
stages.description: Permute the whole last layer in one look. 21 cases in total; these are the most useful to learn first.
stages.goal: One algorithm solves the last layer.

algorithms.name: Common PLLs
algorithms.notation: R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R' U' R U R' F'
algorithms.description: A starter set of one-look PLLs.

cases.name: T-perm
cases.moves: R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R' U' R U R' F'
cases.description: Swaps two adjacent corners and two opposite edges.
cases.recognition: Headlights with a contrasting edge on one side; 2x1 blocks on both neighbours.

cases.name: Ja-perm
cases.moves: R' U L' U2 R U' R' U2 R L
cases.description: Swaps an adjacent corner pair and edge pair.
cases.recognition: A 1x3 bar and a 2x1 block on adjacent sides.

cases.name: Jb-perm
cases.moves: R U R' F' R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R'
cases.description: Mirror of Ja.
cases.recognition: A 1x3 bar on the left and a 2x1 block in front-right.

cases.name: Ra-perm
cases.moves: R U' R' U' R U R D R' U' R D' R' U2 R'
cases.description: Headlights with a split edge.
cases.recognition: Headlights with a contrasting edge between.

cases.name: F-perm
cases.moves: R' U' F' R U R' U' R' F R2 U' R' U' R U R' U R
cases.description: Swaps two corners and two edges on one side.
cases.recognition: One full 1x3 bar and no other solved blocks.

cases.name: Y-perm
cases.moves: F R U' R' U' R U R' F' R U R' U' R' F R F'
cases.description: Swaps diagonal corners and two edges.
cases.recognition: No headlights; two 2x1 blocks.

cases.name: E-perm
cases.moves: x' R U' R' D R U R' D' R U R' D R U' R' D' x
cases.description: Swaps two pairs of corners; no headlights anywhere.
cases.recognition: No headlights and no blocks on any side.

cases.name: Ga-perm
cases.moves: R2 U R' U R' U' R U' R2 U' D R' U R D'
cases.description: Three corners and three edges cycle.
cases.recognition: Headlights with a 2x1 block on an adjacent side.
